design.name: 九尾狐巫
design.brief: The nine-tailed fox (九尾狐) who attends the Queen Mother of the West in Han-dynasty art, frozen into a support caster: an elegant anthropomorphic white fox priestess with sly glowing cyan eyes, nine big fluffy tails fanned behind her like a peacock's tail, ice-blue tail tips, a Han-dynasty layered robe in glacier blue and moon white with a jade pendant belt, a small verdigris bronze headpiece. Hands with a clearly separate thumb and four slender fingers; digitigrade fox legs with four-toed paws. Calm, cunning and regal.
design.weapon: a round Han-dynasty bronze mirror (铜镜) floating in front of her chest by magic, its back carved with a frosted pattern and a big glowing jade knob in the middle (weak spot); her hands do not touch it
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert roster (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast): chunky simplified masses, oversized head and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges, ice as a few big faceted crystal shapes (never thin needles or noisy frost texture), fur as a few large carved clumps. The mirror floats; she holds nothing.
